ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Crop Growth Balance（中世日本 - 作物生育期間調整）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Aligns the growth periods of six Vanilla crops and seven optional Medieval Overhaul crops with the relative crop timing used by AMJ Grains. Only growth days are changed; yields, temperature rules, research and harvested products are preserved. AMJ Grains, Medieval Overhaul and CCTO are optional. Real RimWorld 1.6 crop-function tests passed; separate original Medieval Overhaul audio errors remain. Public release is planned alongside AMJ Grains.
AMJ Grainsの作物生育期間のバランスに合わせて、バニラ6種・任意のMedieval Overhaul作物7種の生育日数を調整する。変更対象は生育日数のみ。収穫数・温度・研究・収穫物は変更しない。AMJ Grains・Medieval Overhaul・CCTOはいずれも任意。RimWorld 1.6で作物機能の実機検証済みだが、MO原本由来の別系統の音声エラーは残る。一般公開はAMJ Grainsと同時に予定。
